output.reason: The release note [ev-126543eb6b57] only says exceptions were added for RBAC-related resources in name validation. The linked PR [ev-5f6f6e0021da] adds that it "loosens the validation for children names for RBAC types", and [ev-412105ba176e] shows the change is in composition_functions.go plus a new internal/names/validate.go. The evidence still doesn't say which RBAC kinds are exempt, what naming rule applies or what it now allows, what used to happen to such composed resources, or whether the stricter check ever shipped in a release. Issue #6687, which describes the failure, isn't shown, so applicability and consequence can't be written yet.
